databaseName: Pajero V78W 4M41 maintenance database - original items enriched

vehicleProfile.vehicle: Mitsubishi Pajero III / Montero / Shogun Gen 3

displayRules.toVerifyLabel: To be added / verify at service

alignmentCheck.note: This version keeps the same maintenance rows as maintenance_source.md and enriches them with part/fluid details where available. It does not split grouped original rows into extra app records.

maintenanceItems.name: Engine oil
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Sooted oil, timing-chain wear, turbo wear, low pressure
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Official schedules disagree by market: one factory Pajero schedule shows 20,000 km/12 mo normal and 10,000 km severe; later Australia schedule shows 15,000 km/12 mo normal and 7,500 km severe. The safe app interval is 7,500 km

fluid.specification: Diesel engine oil suitable for 4M41. Use a quality ACEA/API diesel-rated oil; exact label/spec can be stored after first service.
fluid.capacity: Approx. 9.8 L total including filter and oil cooler; buy 10 L and fill by dipstick.
fluid.serviceFill: Fill gradually and verify on dipstick after start/settle.

parts.note: Buy 10 L for a complete oil service.
Likely engine oil pan drain plug gasket; verify on first oil change.

appNotes: Use 7,500 km / 12 months as main reminder.
User/practical value: buy 10 L, fill by dipstick.

maintenanceItems.name: Oil filter
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Dirty oil, delayed pressure, increased wear
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Do not separate it from oil service on an older 4M41

parts.note: ME013307 is the stronger 4M41/V78W candidate; confirm against removed filter at first change.

appNotes: Change with every engine oil service.

maintenanceItems.name: Air cleaner element
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Smoke, poor power, higher fuel use, turbo dusting risk
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Official severe-use regime is shorter in dust and off-road use

maintenanceItems.name: Air cleaner element
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Restricted airflow, smoke, turbo contamination
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Factory schedule gives 40,000 km normal for diesel; on an old off-road truck 20,000 km is safer

maintenanceItems.name: Fuel filter
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Hard start, surging, rail-pressure faults, pump wear
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Later Australia schedule points to about 30,000 km; conservative app value is 20,000 km/12 mo

maintenanceItems.name: Fuel-filter water / contamination
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Filter lamp, hesitation, corrosion in injection parts
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Check immediately if the fuel-filter lamp or water warning appears

maintenanceItems.name: Coolant level and cooling system
maintenanceItems.partsAndFluidsTextFromOriginal: Correct premix coolant, clamps as needed
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Overheating, heater weakness, hidden coolant loss
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: On LWB vehicles, rear heater pipes are a known corrosion leak point

fluid.specification: Mitsubishi genuine coolant or equivalent, normally mixed 50/50. Do not mix unknown coolant types.
fluid.capacity: System capacity depends on rear heater/cooling configuration; record measured refill at first flush.

maintenanceItems.name: Coolant
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Corrosion, overheating, water-pump wear
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Store the vehicle-confirmed refill amount in the app after the first flush

fluid.specification: Mitsubishi genuine coolant or equivalent, 30–60% concentration, practical 50/50 mix.
fluid.capacity: Approx. 9.0–10.0 L depending on rear heater/cooling configuration; buy 10–12 L premix and record actual refill.
fluid.serviceFill: User must confirm rear heater/rear HVAC circuit on vehicle.

verification.reason: Exact coolant capacity depends on rear heater/cooling configuration.

maintenanceItems.name: Thermostat / radiator / main hoses
maintenanceItems.partsAndFluidsTextFromOriginal: Thermostat, gasket, hoses, clamps if needed
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Slow warm-up, unstable temp, overheating, coolant smell
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: No clean factory replacement interval found; treat as condition-based but inspect at every coolant service

maintenanceItems.name: Accessory belts
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Squeal, no charging, poor cooling
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Especially important because the 4M41 belt condition affects alternator and cooling support systems

fluid.specification: Later factory 4M41 procedure gives measured tension values

parts.note: Separate A/C belt/full belt set still verify from old belt/EPC.

maintenanceItems.name: Accessory belts
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Belt breakage, charging loss, overheating
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: No exact factory replacement interval found in the accessible 2001 material; use age-based preventive replacement

parts.note: Separate A/C belt/full belt set still verify from old belt/EPC.

maintenanceItems.name: Belt pulleys / idlers / tensioners
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Chirp, rough bearing noise, belt throw
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Replace with belts if any roughness or wobble is found

maintenanceItems.name: Vacuum-pump oil hose
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Oil seepage, vacuum-related issues
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Explicitly listed in the factory diesel maintenance schedule

maintenanceItems.name: Intake air hose / turbo oil hose / intercooler path
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Boost leaks, oily misting, poor power
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Check charge-air hoses and intercooler for oil accumulation and leaks

maintenanceItems.name: Turbocharger
maintenanceItems.partsAndFluidsTextFromOriginal: Intake seals, feed/return sealing parts if removed
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Whine, smoke, power loss, oil use
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Inspect shaft play and compressor condition when intake hoses are removed

maintenanceItems.name: Crankcase ventilation / breather hoses
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Oil mist, manifold sludge, external seepage
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Oil mist from the breather mixes with EGR soot and forms the 4M41 intake sludge seen by owners

maintenanceItems.name: EGR system
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Low-speed hesitation, smoke, sticky intake parts
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Factory schedule includes an EGR inspection item; many older vehicles benefit from periodic cleaning

maintenanceItems.name: Intake manifold carbon buildup
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Power loss, smoke, airflow restriction
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Community consensus is that manifold cross-section can reduce badly if EGR and oil mist are left alone

maintenanceItems.name: Glow plugs
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Hard cold start, white smoke, cold misfire
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: No verified fixed replacement interval found; treat as condition-based test item

parts.note: Confirm against removed plug; common specs around 11 V, M10x1.25, 170 mm.

maintenanceItems.name: Injectors / small injection quantity learning
maintenanceItems.partsAndFluidsTextFromOriginal: Diagnostic tool, injector seals if removed
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Rough idle, smoke, knock, economy loss
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: The later factory schedule explicitly includes small-injection-quantity learning; store completed learning in service history

fluid.specification: In applicable common-rail factory documentation, new injectors require code entry

maintenanceItems.name: Supply pump / SCV / rail-pressure system
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Surging, stalling, hard starting, reduced power
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Community pattern strongly links 4M41 surging and light-throttle hunting to SCV/fuel-pressure control faults

maintenanceItems.name: Valve clearance
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Ticking, rough idle, starting trouble
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: The later official 4M41 schedule lists valve-clearance inspection every 20,000 km/12 mo; many owners defer it, but the factory interval is the safest app value

parts.note: Verify exact gasket before valve-clearance service.

maintenanceItems.name: Timing chain / guides / tensioner
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Cold-start rattle, metallic timing noise, catastrophic failure if ignored
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: 4M41 uses a chain, not a belt; early Gen 3 community/specialist reports repeatedly warn about top-guide wear and breakage

fluid.specification: Factory bulletin identifies 4M41 timing-chain kits and replacement procedure

parts.note: Official 4M41 bulletin kit candidate; diagnose before replacement.

maintenanceItems.name: Engine mounts / oil-pressure-switch leak / general 4M41 high-mileage checks
maintenanceItems.partsAndFluidsTextFromOriginal: Mounts or oil-pressure switch as needed
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Vibration, sudden oil leak near turbo/block, clunks
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: The oil-pressure switch leak is a recurring 4M41 complaint and should be checked at every oil service

maintenanceItems.name: ATF level and condition
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Burnt smell, slip, flare, delayed engagement
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Check hot and log colour/odour in the app

fluid.specification: Mitsubishi / Diamond ATF SP III or compatible ATF SP III.
fluid.capacity: Total capacity 9.7 L; for inspection only no refill amount.

maintenanceItems.name: ATF
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Harsh or soft shifts, shudder, temp warning
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Official sources disagree because some later schedules refer to newer 5AT calibrations. For a 2001 V5A51, 40,000 km / 3 years is the safe app interval

fluid.capacity: 9.7 L total. Practical staged service: approx. 4.0 L from cooler hose + 2.0 L drain, then approx. 6.0 L + 4.0 L refill sequence.
fluid.serviceFill: For normal drain/pan service measure removed amount and refill accordingly.

parts.note: A/T oil pan drain plug gasket.

appNotes: Use 40,000 km / 24–36 months as conservative app interval.

maintenanceItems.name: Internal filter / strainer / pan service
maintenanceItems.partsAndFluidsTextFromOriginal: Internal oil filter, strainer seals, pan sealant, O-rings
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Debris circulation, poor shift quality, contaminated ATF
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: On unknown history, do an early pan-drop service rather than assuming “sealed for life”

fluid.capacity: Service amount depends on drained volume.

parts.note: Use sealant, not a pre-cut pan gasket unless later confirmed.

maintenanceItems.name: Cooler lines and cooler / heat exchanger
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: ATF leak, overheating, low fluid
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Extra important if towing or driving slowly off-road

maintenanceItems.name: ATF service method on unknown history
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Post-service shift problems if done badly
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Community and specialist threads favour pan service plus staged drain-and-fills or a controlled specialist flush over a blind aggressive machine flush on a neglected older box

maintenanceItems.name: Transfer case oil
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Chain/bearing wear, noisy case, poor shifting
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Do not use rear-diff GL-5 as the default transfer oil unless a verified equivalent specifically covers the factory requirement

maintenanceItems.name: Transfer case oil leakage / level
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Low oil, whining, oil misting
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Official schedule includes leak/level checks

maintenanceItems.name: Super Select 4WD functional exercise
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Flashing lamps, sticky engagement, reluctant mode changes
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Community consensus is clear: regular exercise helps keep the system free

maintenanceItems.name: Front axle actuator / vacuum lines / vacuum solenoids
maintenanceItems.partsAndFluidsTextFromOriginal: Vacuum hoses, solenoids, actuator boot as needed
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Flashing front-wheel lamps, failure to engage/disengage, grinding
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: One of the best-documented Gen 3 real-world fault patterns

maintenanceItems.name: 4WD switches and sensors / indicator diagnosis
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Persistent blinking lamps, false mode display
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Sticky or worn detection switches are a common Gen 3 cause of flashing lights

fluid.specification: V5A51 transfer documentation lists 2WD, 4H, centre-diff-lock and 4LLc-related switches

maintenanceItems.name: Front differential oil
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Whine, bearing wear
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Official check method says oil should not be more than 8 mm below filler-hole lower edge

fluid.specification: Hypoid gear oil API GL-5 or higher, SAE 90/80W or suitable 75W-90 GL-5.

maintenanceItems.name: Rear differential oil
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Whine, gear wear, chatter if wrong lube used
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Verify whether this exact vehicle has an LSD or locker before final fluid assignment

fluid.specification: For user-verified rear diff service: API GL-5 gear oil. Do not use LSD oil unless LSD is physically confirmed.
fluid.capacity: 1.6 L verified on this vehicle; buy 2 L.

verification.reason: User measured/used 1.6 L during service on this vehicle.

appNotes: User verified fill on this car: 1.6 L. Buy 2 L.

maintenanceItems.name: Rear LSD / locker verification
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Wrong oil selection, poor locking behaviour
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: V78W equipment varies by market/trim; confirm hardware before hard-coding fluid SKUs in the app

parts.role: Rear diff lock air line hose

appNotes: Use as equipment verification/check item, not a normal fluid service.

maintenanceItems.name: Prop shafts, U-joints and slip joints
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Clunk, vibration, seized U-joints
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Factory schedule explicitly includes propeller-shaft greasing

fluid.capacity: As needed until clean grease purges.

maintenanceItems.name: CV boots and axle seals
maintenanceItems.partsAndFluidsTextFromOriginal: Boot kits, CV grease, axle seals if needed
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Grease fling, clicks, oil contamination
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Severe-use schedule shortens boots checks

maintenanceItems.name: Wheel bearings
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Rumble, wheel play, hot hub, ABS issues
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Community experience repeatedly warns against poor-quality aftermarket bearings on Gen 3/4 Pajeros

parts.note: Supersession/candidate group; verify by side/old part before ordering.

maintenanceItems.name: Brake fluid
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Soft pedal, corrosion, poor HBB/ABS behaviour
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: More important than average because this vehicle uses a hydraulic brake booster system

fluid.specification: DOT 3 or DOT 4 from sealed container.
fluid.capacity: Flush amount to be measured; buy 1.0–1.5 L for normal flush.

maintenanceItems.name: Pads and discs
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Noise, pull, vibration, reduced braking
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Official severe-use schedule shortens brake inspection

parts.note: 290 x 26 mm candidate; measure before order.
300 x 22 mm candidate; measure before order.

maintenanceItems.name: Calipers and guide pins
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Uneven pad wear, dragging brakes
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Common ageing-service item even though not listed as a separate factory replacement row

maintenanceItems.name: Parking brake (drum-in-disc)
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Long travel, poor hill-hold
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Store post-adjustment lever travel in the app if possible

maintenanceItems.name: Brake hoses and hard lines
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Cracks, leaks, sudden line failure
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Pay extra attention to rear sections and wheel-arch exits on salted-road vehicles

maintenanceItems.name: ABS / HBB code scan and warning-lamp diagnosis
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: ABS lamp, brake lamp, buzzer, pump cycling
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Log codes in the app, not just parts replaced

maintenanceItems.name: HBB pump operation and accumulator health
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Long pump run, buzzing, hard pedal, warning lamp
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Factory troubleshooting sets **code 55** if the pump motor runs for 300 seconds and **code 57** if accumulator pressure is too low
appNotes: Condition-based diagnostic item only. Do not treat HBB accumulator as a normal recurring maintenance part.

maintenanceItems.name: HBB accumulator / pump motor / relays
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Warning buzzer, poor reserve assist, repeated pump run
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Community and official diagnostic trees both show this is one of the major Gen 3 braking weak points

parts.note: Only if symptoms/faults confirm accumulator issue; verify against installed part.

appNotes: Do not show as due by mileage. Use only when HBB symptoms/codes are present.

maintenanceItems.name: Suspension system general
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Clunks, looseness, tyre wear
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Good baseline under-vehicle inspection item

maintenanceItems.name: Upper and lower ball joints / dust boots
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Play, knock, alignment drift
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: One of the must-check front-end items on a high-mileage Gen 3

maintenanceItems.name: Control-arm bushes / stabiliser links / stabiliser bushes
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Harshness, small-bump rattles, wandering
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: No separate factory replacement interval; inspect with every suspension check

maintenanceItems.name: Tie rods / steering linkage / seals and boots
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Steering play, toe wear, wandering
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Factory schedule includes steering-linkage inspection

parts.role: Outer tie rod end RH candidate
Inner tie rod / rack end candidate

maintenanceItems.name: Steering-column joints / intermediate shaft
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Column clunk, notchiness
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Less common than tie-rod wear but worth annual attention on an ageing truck

maintenanceItems.name: Shocks and springs / ride height
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Bounce, float, rear sag
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: High-mileage owner experience regularly points to softness before obvious leakage

maintenanceItems.name: Wheel alignment
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Tyre wear, pull, off-centre wheel
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Recheck after any ball-joint, bush or shock work

parts.role: Alignment service / adjustment hardware if seized

maintenanceItems.name: Chassis and underbody corrosion
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Structural rust, seized fixings
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Must be annual at minimum on salted-road European vehicles

maintenanceItems.name: Brake-line and fuel-line corrosion points
maintenanceItems.partsAndFluidsTextFromOriginal: Line clips, repair material as needed
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Wet lines, scale, MOT failure
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Concentrate on rear wheel-arch exits and underbody channels

maintenanceItems.name: Rear wheel arches / sills / door bottoms / tailgate seams
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Bubble rust, hidden seam corrosion
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Common hidden-rust zones on ageing Pajero/Shogun bodies

maintenanceItems.name: Fuel-tank area / straps / nearby lines
maintenanceItems.partsAndFluidsTextFromOriginal: Tank straps or hardware as needed
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Rust at tank cradle, seepage
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Mud and salt collect here

maintenanceItems.name: Body mounts and fasteners
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Body movement, clunks, seized mount bolts
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Important before heavy rustproofing or major chassis work

maintenanceItems.name: Sunroof drains
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Wet headlining, damp carpets
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: If fitted, treat as annual preventive maintenance

parts.role: Drain cleaning tool / compressed air / flexible line

maintenanceItems.name: Underbody wax / cavity protection
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Rust progression each winter
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Best done after cleaning and drying, not over trapped damp corrosion

maintenanceItems.name: Rear heater pipes / rear HVAC hard lines
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Coolant loss, weak rear heat/cool, underbody rust
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Very common long-wheelbase issue and worth its own app reminder

maintenanceItems.name: Battery state / electrolyte / case condition
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Slow crank, low-voltage faults, HBB/ABS nuisance faults
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Later owner/manual material says serviceable batteries should be checked very regularly; six-month app checks are sensible even if a battery tester is not used every time

parts.note: User reports likely 2x95 Ah setup; verify dimensions, polarity and CCA before purchase.

maintenanceItems.name: Alternator charging voltage / belt load
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Dim lamps, battery not charging
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Record actual charging voltage in service notes

maintenanceItems.name: Grounds / earth points / starter cables
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Slow crank, strange sensor faults, intermittent electrical issues
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Age and corrosion make this a very worthwhile preventive task

maintenanceItems.name: Fuses / relays / lighting / dash warning bulbs
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Hidden faults if warning lamps do not work
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Important because 4WD and HBB systems often rely on dash warnings

maintenanceItems.name: OBD / MUT scan of engine, A/T, ABS/HBB and 4WD
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Hidden pending faults, no-code drivability issues
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Store codes and freeze-frame notes, not just a “done” flag

maintenanceItems.name: Common failing engine-control sensors
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Surging, no-start, reduced power, oil leak
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Community reports repeatedly mention SCV, MAF/MAP, crank-angle/rpm signal problems and oil-pressure-switch leakage on 4M41s

maintenanceItems.name: Cabin / air-purifier filter
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Weak airflow, odour, fogging
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: One of the cleanest verified factory intervals available
appNotes: Treat as fitted-likely but verify physical slot.

maintenanceItems.name: A/C service / leak test / refrigerant service
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Warm air, poor cooling, noisy compressor
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Do not hard-code later-model refrigerant mass into the app without checking this vehicle’s label

fluid.specification: R134a; final authority is under-bonnet A/C label.
fluid.capacity: Reference only: approx. 550±20 g without rear evaporator / 750±20 g with rear evaporator. Record label value before service.

verification.reason: Exact charge must come from the under-bonnet label.

maintenanceItems.name: Condenser / evaporator drain / blower motor / heater core / rear heater
maintenanceItems.partsAndFluidsTextFromOriginal: Cleaner, blower parts or hose parts if needed
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Odour, wet carpets, weak airflow, coolant smell
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Rear heater plumbing on the long-wheelbase vehicle deserves special attention

maintenanceItems.name: Seat mechanisms
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Stiff adjusters
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Annual cabin-detail task

maintenanceItems.name: Locks, hinges, bonnet and tailgate latches
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Stiff locks, latch wear
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Good before winter and after washing or rustproofing

maintenanceItems.name: Window regulators and channels
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Slow windows, grinding, dropped glass
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Check drain membranes if doors are damp inside

maintenanceItems.name: Wiper blades and washer system
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Streaking, blocked jets, poor visibility
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Some Pajeros have rear washer reservoir/service points in the back door area

parts.note: Common catalogue reference: 550/500 mm; verify on vehicle.

maintenanceItems.name: Tailgate / spare carrier / back-door hardware
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Door sag, rattles, seized fasteners
maintenanceItems.originalNotes: Important on vehicles carrying weight on the rear door or spare mount
